description:
The wire records of the fleet model service, chat memory snapshots, and
    usage entries: plain Java with no framework type, in the package the
    space names them by, so a Spring AI peer and a Micronaut LangChain4j peer
    serve each other's model calls, resume each other's conversations, and
    sum usage as one fleet. Golden CBOR vectors pin the bytes. A standalone
    project both agentspaces-springai and agentspaces-micronaut depend on.
